rows.26:dd60:
"Aaaaaaagh!"
He screamed.
Because his whole face was covered in scales, packed tight.
The very same scales he'd torn off that koi the day before...
And on the side of his neck, a fish's gills were flapping open and shut.
By then, he couldn't make a sound anymore.
All you could hear was the wheezing whistle of gills breathing.
And webbing had grown between his fingers...{p}
rows.26:e230:
"Aww, there, there.
You want me to torment you that badly?"
He said it with a grin.
Then he pinned the koi down with his foot and peeled off its scales one by one.{p}
rows.26:e3b4:
"Squeeeeeee!"
The koi let out a sound like a scream.
Of course he couldn't carve up a koi as neatly as a real chef.
By the time he'd pulled out its guts and cut into its back, the koi had stopped moving.
That was when he learned something for the first time.
When a koi gets that big, it bleeds red blood, just like a human...{p}
rows.26:e560: In a rage, he hacked the koi in front of him to shreds.{p}
rows.26:e5b0:
Then he flushed the chunks of koi flesh down the toilet.
He'd thought it would give him more fun than that... A little let down, he left the restroom.{p}
